g.text: A membership that makes a plausible plan, confirms it, then deliberately cancels it — so the
evening stays yours and no attendance is expected.
A silent member is still a successful member.
Attended, checked-in and no-show states are forbidden by design.
Confirmed facts need a source; members control their memory.
A real-looking plan lands in the calendar.
The member accepts, with no attendance implied.
The plan is deliberately called off.
The evening, and the relationship, continue.
